Introduction.SourceString: 习惯与人保持距离的冷面行动派。
Introduction.LocalizedString: A cold, distant type who's used to keeping people at arm's length.

Content.SourceString:
虽然礼数周全却让人感到疏远，作为忽然被调到海特洛市异象管理局本部的收容组成员，真红给同事们的第一印象并不算好，除了某位让人怀疑「缺乏部分生活常识」的收容组明星员工外，绝大多数人跟真红的距离都被她刻意地保持在了一个「合适」的位置。
不仅仅是工作，生活中的真红同样保持这样的状态。她会在上新季出现在人流涌动的DSD去抢购最新款的盲盒，也会出现在万众瞩目的异象集换卡决赛的观众席，跟坐在身边同好聊起自己的收藏。但当人潮散去，留下的永远是真红独自归家的背影。生活在一个繁华的大都市，她没有拒绝与人的联系，也从来没有让任何人进入自己的「领地」。
尽管这的确带来了一些非议和误会，但真红坚定的认为这样是最正确的选择。自从那场大雨之后，她已经习惯了孤身一人。

曾经的真红始终认为自己跟同龄人没多少区别，直到那场大雨让她明白了自己与生俱来的力量意味着什么，也彻底地改变了她的生活。
在刚刚离开海特洛跟随师傅在分部的收容九组学习的时候，真红曾想过「如果这一切都没有发生」会如何，但很快她便将这个没有答案的问题扔在一边，并且找到了对自己来说避免过去的悲剧重现最好的方式——只要跟大家保持距离就好了。
于是，下定决心的幼龙开始成长。
她开始尝试自己承受一切，在各位前辈的帮助下变得能够独当一面甚至保护其他人，独来独往的行动风格让她即使失控也能将影响降到最低。一切好像都在步入正轨，直到师傅将调任书交给她，验证她是否走出了那个雨夜的契机出现了。

过往是最精明的猎人，会在猎物最松懈的时候给予致命一击。
但显然，一条逐渐成熟的龙，绝非坐以待毙的猎物。
Content.LocalizedString:
There's a distance in Shinku's politeness. As a new CSU member transferred to the BAC's HQ at Hethereau, Shinku didn't exactly make a great first impression on colleagues. Shinku maintained a deliberate distance and kept people at their "right places"—with the exception of that star employee who is known for lacking common sense.
It's not just at work, Shinku practices the same thing in her daily life too. She'll show up in the crowd rushing towards DSD to grab the latest Mystery Box or sit in the packed stands at the finals of the anomaly trading card championship, chatting with fellow fans about her collection. But once the crowds clear out, it's always Shinku going home by herself. Living in a bustling city, she's never refused to contact anyone, but she's also never let anyone into her "territory" either.
Shinku's definitely sparked some criticism and caused misunderstandings, but she firmly believes she's making the right calls. Ever since that heavy rain, she's grown used to being on her own.

There was a time when Shinku believed she wasn't different from kids her age, until that heavy rain made her understand what the power she'd been born with actually implied. Since then, her life has been completely different.
When Shinku first left Hethereau to train under her mentor at CSU-9, she wondered what would've happened if the incident had never ever occurred. But soon, she set that unanswerable question aside and found what she thought was the best way to keep the same tragedy from happening again—she just kept everyone at a distance.
And so, the determined dragonling began to grow.
She started bearing every burden on her own. With the help of her senior colleagues, she grew capable enough to handle things solo and even protect others. Her lone-wolf style meant that even if she lost control, the impact could be kept to a minimum. Everything seemed to be falling into place, until the day her mentor handed her the transfer papers, and the chance to see whether she'd truly moved past that rainy night finally arrived.

The past is the sharpest hunter, striking its killing blow the moment its prey lets its guard down.
But apparently, a maturing dragon isn't that kind of prey.

Content.SourceString:
能够显著的提升反应速度和肉体强度，真红的异能带给她的战斗力提升让她在加入异象管理局的初期很快地适应了自己的工作，但尚且缺乏控制力导致的暴走也是她急需解决的问题。经常能看到真红清醒后对着自己造成的烂摊子陷入低气压，不过作为一名行动派，她很快就决定了自己该怎么做。在她第三次因为没带安全帽被安全员赶出重建的工地后，她便做出了这么一顶两侧开洞，能让自己的角穿过的安全帽。
「……所以你就非得去工地上帮忙？」
「嗯。」
「戴着这个……看起来没什么意义的安全帽？」
「工地上是这么要求的，不戴不让进。」
好消息是，这顶帽子已经很久没有派上用场了。
Content.LocalizedString:
Shinku's powers boost her reaction speed and physical strength. In the early days at the Bureau, her combat prowess helped her quickly adapt to her responsibilities. But her lack of control meant she'd often go berserk, and that was something she urgently needed to fix. It wasn't uncommon to see Shinku fall into a dark mood right after coming to, staring at the mess she made. Still, biased to action, she was quick to find a solution. After a safety officer kicked her off a construction site for not wearing a hard hat for the third time, she made herself a helmet with holes on both sides for her horns.
"Do you really have to… go to the construction site?"
"Mhm."
"And you have to wear this… pointless helmet?"
"That's a requirement. I can't enter the site if I don't wear one."
At least the helmet hasn't been needed for a while.

Content.SourceString:
一开始皱着眉头叫她没礼貌的小鬼，后来会开心地在外勤时带着她跑去买冰淇淋的坦帕斯；会在她失控后躲在房间里自责时故意来找她开玩笑的丽；在训练时总是板着脸，在她失误时毫不留情地发火，在任务中却总会站在她身前的师姐；虽然从来没在嘴上说过，却从没忘记她生日的师傅，如果没有他们，恐怕自己永远都只能躲在房间里自怨自艾。
究竟该如何回应他们的关心与帮助，除了让自己成为能够独当一面的人之外，真红想不到任何的答案。
所以，现在师傅眼中的担忧一定是因为自己还不够独立，还不够强。
Content.LocalizedString:
Tempus, who used to frown and call her a rude brat, would later happily bring her out for ice cream during field assignments; Ray, who'd look for her and crack jokes when Shinku was holed up in the room blaming herself for losing control; her senior sister, who always kept a straight face during training and never held back her anger when Shinku messed up, but would nevertheless stand before her on missions; and her mentor, who usually kept quiet about her birthdays but never forgot to celebrate… without them, Shinku probably would've been stuck in her room feeling sorry for herself forever.
As for how she should respond to their concerns and goodwill, Shinku couldn't think of any other answer aside from becoming someone who could stand on her own.
Her mentor must be worried only because she's still not independent and strong enough.

Content.SourceString:
独自走在海边，时不时地将挡在面前的石头踢开，尽管视线逐渐变得模糊但还是倔强地将在眼眶里打转的眼泪憋回去。
「不就是个蛋糕，我才不稀罕！」
不是的，自己当时并不是想说这个。
随着自己越来越容易在夜晚伴随着头顶传来的疼痛醒来，在班级里说出让自己后悔的话语的次数也越来越多。明明心里想的并不是这样，回过神来自己却总是要么惹得同学生气，要么惹得同学大哭。
好讨厌这样。
其实自己想跟他们一起玩躲避球，想跟他们一起准备晚会上的节目，想在同学的生日宴会上一起吃蛋糕、吹蜡烛，唱生日歌，但自己却总是将一切都搞砸……
「真红！」
「找到你了，我就知道你会在这。」
「看我找到了什么，当当！这里跟这里，像不像现在哭成一团的某个人？」
「……才没有。」
「明明就一样！给。」
「……？」
「故事里的恶龙不都有自己的宝藏吗？那条喜欢跟大家吵架的恶龙也应该有！以后每次跟别人吵架了就来收集有趣的东西吧，这样等什么时候真红打败了那条恶龙之后就可以跟大家一起分享它的宝藏了！」
从那枚哭丧着脸的贝壳开始，真红开始了她的「寻宝」历程。
Content.LocalizedString:
Walking alone along the beach, kicking away pebbles that got in her way now and then. Even as her vision started to blur, she held back the tears welling up in her eyes.
"It's just a cake. It's not like I care about it!"
No, that's not what was on her mind.
The more often she started waking up at night with a pain from the top of her head, the more often she'd say things in class that she'd end up regretting. Deep down, she really didn't mean those things, but by the time she came to her senses, she'd either made her classmates angry or made them cry.
She didn't like that.
The truth is, she wanted to play dodgeball with them, wanted to help prepare the school festival performance, wanted to eat cake, blow out the candles, and sing happy birthday at her classmates' birthday parties. But somehow, she always ended up ruining everything…
"Shinku!"
"Found ya! I knew you'd be here!"
"Look what I found! Tada! Here! Doesn't this remind you of someone who's curled up into a ball crying?"
"That's… not true."
"It is! Anyway, take it."
"Huh…？"
"Doesn't every evil dragon in a story have their own stash of treasures? That dragon who loves picking fights with everyone should have some too! So from now on, every time you get into a fight with someone, collect something fun. That way, once you finally defeat the evil dragon, you can share its stash with everyone!"
Starting with that shell with the sad little face on it, Shinku began her "treasure hunt."

Content.SourceString:
对于真红而言，调入收容二组后，两位她不得不熟悉的新同事远比换个环境来得更有挑战。
薄荷，一位让真红所有跟人保持距离的招式全数失效的奇人，无论是摆出冷脸还是借口有事，她总能当成耳旁风继续往你身边挤。冷脸？怎么这么不开心，谁又惹果果生气啦！还是说测试没通过？有事？那好啊，下次再约吧，明天下班后怎么样？
仿佛完全不懂得什么叫客气，只是因为自己想就向你蹭了过来，这的确是个麻烦……不过真红并不讨厌，谁会讨厌一只亲近人的猫呢？
至于另一位……
奥涅伊洛伊，在真红跟她的第一次合作后她便理解了自己被调到收容二组的原因，这只羊拥有着能够让自己从暴走中恢复的能力。对真红来说这本应是个好消息，她终于不用顾虑自己会伤害到队友，但真红却无法像接受薄荷那样接受她——
伊洛伊并没有将真实的自己表现出来，她有所隐瞒。
简直就像真红自己一样。
Content.LocalizedString:
For Shinku, the challenge of transferring to CSU-2 was more about getting along with the two new teammates than about getting used to a new place.
Mint. A one-of-a-kind character who somehow invalidates Shinku's tricks to keep her distance. Whether Shinku puts on a resting drake face or makes up an excuse, Mint just brushes it off and keeps approaching her. "Resting drake face? Aww, why so grumpy, who made Taya angry this time? Or did you fail an exam?" "Busy? Sure, let's do it another time then! How about after work tomorrow?"
Mint does not know when to back off. She's just there because she wants to be. It's a hassle, really… but Shinku doesn't hate it—who hates a friendly kitty anyway?
As for the other teammate…
Oneiroi. After Shinku's first mission with her, she understood exactly why she'd been transferred to Unit 2. This one had the ability to prevent her from going berserk. This should have been good news for Shinku, because she'd finally stop worrying about hurting teammates. But she couldn't bring herself to accept Oneiroi the way she accepted Mint.
Iroi was hiding herself. She wasn't showing her true self…
And that was what Shinku was exactly doing.

Content.SourceString:
直到现在，真红仍会时不时地回想起那个雨夜。
颠倒的世界，从积水中出现穿着黑西装的人影，朋友恐惧的求救声，随后自己的记忆便是一片混沌。她成功地击退了那些异象，但随后的暴走也造成了不小的破坏，甚至波及了她想要保护的朋友。
「至少，现在的结果比你只能懊悔自己什么都做不到来的要好。」
即使一直都没能走出那场雨，真红也从未怀疑过自己当时的选择，她在很多时候都想过「如果没有异能就好了」，但绝对不是在那样的情境下。
Content.LocalizedString:
Even now, Shinku still finds herself thinking back to that rainy night.
The world turned upside down, figures in black suits rising up out of puddles, and her friend's terrified cries for help. After that, her memory becomes a blur. She managed to fight off those anomalies, but the rampage that followed caused no small amount of damage, and even swept up the friend she was trying to protect.
"At least that's better than being stuck with regret over doing nothing."
Though she'd never quite made it out of that rain, Shinku had never once doubted the choice she made that night. There had been plenty of times she'd wished she didn't have her Esper Abilities, but never in a moment like that one.

Content.SourceString:
「那我就先回家了哟~」
「茶茶再见！没想到果果居然会主动喊我们出来玩，下次也要记得喊我们，拜拜！」
虽然自己不是很擅长，不过，她们今天应该玩得还算开心吧？这样想着，真红掏出手机，输入那个费了一番功夫才找到的号码，却迟迟没有拨出。
明明在那场薄荷组织的游戏之后就下定决心要做的事，现在又开始犹豫了吗？
想要保护朋友反而导致朋友受伤，认定了对方会讨厌自己所以就远远地躲开，还用「这样就是最好的做法」当借口让自己安心……
自己不是，也绝不能成为这样的胆小鬼。
深呼吸，真红按下拨号键。
「嘟……」
自己应该说些什么？像是忽然才意识到这个问题，真红的呼吸也因为紧张而变得急促。
「你好？」
听筒中传来陌生又有些熟悉的问好声，真红屏住呼吸。
没关系的，因为我们是朋友。
「……喂？嗯，是我。」
「我回来了。」
一直被困在那个雨夜的少女，终于看到了明媚的阳光。
Content.LocalizedString:
"Alright, I'm heading home!"
"Bye, Teana! I didn't think Taya would invite us to play! Call us next time, bye!"
She's not exactly good at this, but they probably had a good time, didn't they? With that thought, Shinku pulled out her phone and typed in the number she worked so hard to find but couldn't bring herself to call.
She made up her mind to do this after that gaming session Mint had put together, so why was she hesitating now?
Wanting to protect a friend but ending up hurting them, deciding on her own that they must hate her and ghosting them, then using "this is for the best" as an excuse to make herself better…
That's not who she is, and it's not who she can ever let herself become.
Taking a deep breath, Shinku pressed the call button.
*Phone rings*
What should she even say? That thought just hit her. Shinku's breathing shortened as she became nervous.
"Hello?"
The voice on the other end was both familiar and unfamiliar. Shinku still held her breath.
It's okay, because we're friends.
"…Hello…? Yeah, it's me."
"I'm back."
The girl who had been trapped in that rainy night for so long finally saw the bright, warm sunlight of the day.

Content.SourceString: 我是真红，隶属于收容二组，你就是薄荷常常提到的可可吧？初次见面，不出意外的话，我应该不会像那只笨猫一样给你添麻烦。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm Shinku from CSU-2. You're Coco, the one Mint mentions a lot, right? Nice to meet you. I hope I won't give you as much trouble as the dumcat.

Content.SourceString: 虽然不像尾巴那样在战斗时很有用，不过除了测身高，这两只角平时也没有尾巴那么不方便。
Content.LocalizedString: They're not as useful in battle as my tail, but the horns don't bother me as much as my tail does, except when measuring my height.

Content.SourceString: 呗果上看到海特洛新开了几家不错的中古店，有空去看看吧。
Content.LocalizedString: On Bagel, I noticed a few vintage shops just opened in Hethereau. Let's take a look when we can.

Content.SourceString: 我从来没有做过一边喷火，一边抓着敌人飞到天上绕几圈再把人扔下来这样的事，这都从哪流传出来的说法……
Content.LocalizedString: I don't have wings, I don't spit fire, and I don't grab my enemies and circle around in the sky before body-slamming them. Seriously, who made this up…?

Content.SourceString: 这么好的天气，去广场上没准能抓到薄荷。
Content.LocalizedString: The weather is so good, we might run into Mint at a square.

Content.SourceString: 又下雨了，啧，麻烦……
Content.LocalizedString: It's raining again. Tch, trouble…

Content.SourceString: 虽说是不冷……总之，快点把事情做完回去吧。
Content.LocalizedString: It's not like I'm cold… but let's get this over with.

Content.SourceString: 想吃棒冰啊……
Content.LocalizedString: I could use an ice pop now…

Content.SourceString: 早，一大早就这么有干劲，要不你替我去巡逻？
Content.LocalizedString: Morning. You look like you're motivated. Wanna take my patrolling shift?

Content.SourceString: 要一起去吃拉面吗？我正好知道一家老店，还在上学的时候经常去，味道不错。
Content.LocalizedString: Do you want to get ramen? There's this old ramen store I used to go to when I was still in school. It tastes great.

Content.SourceString: 希望今晚不会有突然出现的报告……
Content.LocalizedString: I hope there isn't a sudden report to turn in tonight…

Content.SourceString: 不早了，你应该不用我送你回家吧？那就明天见，晚安。
Content.LocalizedString: It's getting late. You don't have to send me home, do you? See you tomorrow. Good night.

Content.SourceString: 上到「DSD」跟《公爵K》限时联名盲盒的大隐藏，下到《周刊Fantasy》的错版杂志，甚至是在海边形状有趣的石头，只要是我感兴趣的东西都会收集起来。想看？有机会再说。
Content.LocalizedString: I collect anything that catches my eye: from the ultra-secret editions of DSD's collab Mystery Boxes with Duke K, to misprinted issues of Weekly Fantasy—even simply cool rocks I come across by the beach. Wanna see? Maybe next time.

Content.SourceString: 最近生活费又告急了，真不想动存起来的那些……
Content.LocalizedString: My funds are running a bit low. I really don't want to touch my savings…

Content.SourceString: 《新收容安全条例》里的要求那么多，执行任务时总得考虑半天……真麻烦。不过，强迫自己背下这些条条框框，有意识地去约束自己，就是我真正需要的吧。这也是我加入收容组的原因。
Content.LocalizedString: The "New Containment Safety Protocol" is bothersome. There are so many rules, and whenever I'm on a mission, I'm forced to think twice before I act. Still, training myself to follow those annoying restrictions when my powers are affecting me is the reason I'm here.

Content.SourceString: 没什么安排的时候，我喜欢漫无目的地四处闲逛，走到哪算哪，遇到些感兴趣的东西还能充实一下收藏。用幼稚一点的说法，小时候的我喜欢把这个过程叫做寻宝，是不是还挺像的。
Content.LocalizedString: When I don't have plans, I like walking around without a destination in mind. I'll roam into random places, and when I see things that interest me, I collect them. When I was little, I called this "treasure hunting." It's still accurate, right?

Content.SourceString: 纳库佩达收藏硬币的方式其实挺不错的，放到许愿池里，每天一睁眼就能看到，也怪不得那家伙天天乐呵呵的，或许我心情不好时也能参考一下？
Content.LocalizedString: Nacupeda is an expert at keeping coins: just stash them in the pool and keep them within eyesight. No wonder that anomaly is always happy. Maybe I should do something similar?

Content.SourceString: 前组长曾说我的能力是诅咒，虽然让我拥有了足够的力量，却也可能给我珍视的事物带去毁灭。过去的我曾因伤害朋友而陷入迷茫……但现在的我明白了：就算是诅咒也好，它能让我在危机来临时不必哀叹自身的弱小，这就够了。
Content.LocalizedString: My former captain told me that my power is a curse. Though it makes me strong, it could also destroy the things I love. I was once depressed because I injured a friend by mistake… But now I understand: I'll embrace my power as long as I don't have to hate myself for being weak when I need to be strong.

Content.SourceString: 在局里总是独来独往？那只笨猫怎么什么都往外说……而且也不算独来独往吧，她不是天天拉着我跟伊洛伊想找点事做吗？
Content.LocalizedString: "I always go solo in the Bureau?" That dumcat just blabbers around… Well, I can't really be alone if she always drags me and Iroi around, can I?

Content.SourceString: 异能对我的影响不仅仅体现在战斗时，即使是平常我也可能忽然做出些出格的事情，虽然不会像战斗时那么危险，不过，我也不知道我可能会做出什么事——或许，可能会变得很麻烦吧。
Content.LocalizedString: My Esper Abilities affect me beyond fights. Even in everyday situations, I might suddenly do something out of line. It wouldn't be as dangerous as during a fight, but I don't know what I might end up doing—that could mean trouble.

Content.SourceString: 薄荷「前辈」，完全没有阅读环境的能力，就算你想要跟她保持距离她也一定会自说自话地凑过来。唉，真是让人没法放着不管的笨猫。
Content.LocalizedString: Mint "senpai" has absolutely no talent in reading the room. Even if you want to keep your distance, she still comes over to talk to you. Sigh, I still can't leave that dumcat alone.

Content.SourceString: 不管在什么时候什么场合都能坦率地表达自己的想法，真不知道是该夸她还是该说她是个大心脏的笨猫……不过，如果大家都能像薄荷这样坦率，麻烦事也会少很多吧。
Content.LocalizedString: That dumcat, she never shies away from expressing her true thoughts and feelings. I don't know if I should praise her for that or just call her thick-skinned… Still, if everyone was as straightforward as Mint, things would be a lot easier.

Content.SourceString: 以同事的标准来评价的话，伊洛伊几乎无可挑剔，让我与她共事恐怕也是因为她能在我失控时通过「梦境」让我冷静下来吧。不过，我曾在「梦境」中看到了……总之，我没法把她当普通人看待，当然，这不会影响到工作。
Content.LocalizedString: As far as colleagues go, Iroi is pretty much perfect. I was probably paired with her because when I lose control, she can calm me down with her dreams, which was where I saw… never mind. Anyway, I don't see her as a normal person, but it doesn't affect our work.

Content.SourceString: 每个人都有自己无法轻易说出口的故事，之前的我是这样，天线羊也不例外。虽然还是不太清楚她到底经历过什么，但我能做的就是相信并陪在她身边，和面对那条龙时她们的选择一样。拌嘴？我倒也希望能不跟她拌嘴，没办法，或许「同伴」就是这样的咯。
Content.LocalizedString: Everyone has a story they don't want to tell. I was like that before. It's the same for Ramtenna. I'm not exactly sure what she's been through, but the least I can do is be by her side—like my teammates were by my side when we faced the Crimson Dragon. The bickering? I prefer to not bicker with her, but maybe that's what companions do.

Content.SourceString: 本以为来这边又要遇到些麻烦，多亏了薄荷，收容二组的同事很快就接受了我，反倒是我到这边第一次出任务就差点把事情闹大，还好有伊洛伊在……咳咳，等等请同事们喝抽风猫吧。
Content.LocalizedString: I thought I was going to go through some troubles when I first transferred to CSU-2, but thanks to Mint, colleagues accepted me quickly. In contrast, I almost made a big blunder on my first mission. Good thing that Iroi was there to help… Ahem, I should buy my colleagues some drinks from Crazy Cat.

Content.SourceString: 先声明一下，我不是在攻击同事，不过异象管理局真是个怪胎集合地，像收容组和E.T.D这些需要出外勤，经常跟危险异象打交道的岗位更是。现在想想，当时的我能很快融入异象管理局，开始跟着前组长学习也多亏了这没多少正常人吧。
Content.LocalizedString: For the record, I'm not dissing my colleagues. I just wanted to say that the BAC is made up of a bunch of weirdos, especially the CSUs and ETDs, which require fieldwork and dealing with dangerous anomalies. Now that I think about it, I was able to blend into the Bureau and learn from my former captain because there weren't many "normal people" around to begin with.

Content.SourceString: 这样，就能自己解决更麻烦的对手了。
Content.LocalizedString: Now I can fight stronger enemies on my own.

Content.SourceString: 虽然可能会带来麻烦，但变强总是好事。
Content.LocalizedString: This might mean trouble, but getting stronger is a good thing.

Content.SourceString: 还不够，还需要更多……！
Content.LocalizedString: Not enough… I need more…!

Content.SourceString: ……！送给我可就不能后悔了。
Content.LocalizedString: …! Don't regret giving me this.

Content.SourceString: 你很懂我的口味嘛。
Content.LocalizedString: You know what I like.

Content.SourceString: 谢了，我会把它放到我的收藏里的。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you. I'll add it to my stash.

Content.SourceString: 有什么要我帮忙的吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is there anything I can help with?

Content.SourceString: 还差得远呢。
Content.LocalizedString: Far from it.

Content.SourceString: 一鼓作气……！
Content.LocalizedString: All in one go…!

Content.SourceString: 能接住的话……尽管试试！
Content.LocalizedString: Take this… if you can!

Content.SourceString: 只要……挥舞这利爪！
Content.LocalizedString: I must… swing my claws!

Content.SourceString: 这就是……你的下场！
Content.LocalizedString: Fool around… and find out!

Content.SourceString: 将愤怒！释放出来！
Content.LocalizedString: Releasing! All my anger!

Content.SourceString: 这些害虫……
Content.LocalizedString: These pests…

Content.SourceString: 闪开！……别被卷进来了！
Content.LocalizedString: Get out! Don't get dragged into this!

Content.SourceString: 好烦……给我安静安静、安静、安静，安静一点！
Content.LocalizedString: Annoying… silence, silence, siLEncE, SILENCE!

Content.SourceString: 就此结束吧……！
Content.LocalizedString: This is the end…!

Content.SourceString: 不会放你离开……！
Content.LocalizedString: You're stuck here with me…!

Content.SourceString: 在找逃命的路线吗——想都别想！
Content.LocalizedString: Plotting your escape? Don't even think about it!

Content.SourceString: 你最好老实点，让我能安心交差。
Content.LocalizedString: Stay still and let me do my job.

Content.SourceString: 收容完成，一切顺利。
Content.LocalizedString: Containment complete. It went smoothly.

Content.SourceString: 真是给人添麻烦的家伙……
Content.LocalizedString: What a hassle…

Content.SourceString: 敬酒不吃吃罚酒。
Content.LocalizedString: You just had to choose the hard way.

Content.SourceString: 运气不错，今天应该去一趟DSD。
Content.LocalizedString: Pretty lucky day. I should visit DSD.

Content.SourceString: 不错，找到了些有用的东西。
Content.LocalizedString: I found some useful stuff. Not bad at all.

Content.SourceString: 会是什么好东西呢？
Content.LocalizedString: What good stuff will I get?

Content.SourceString: 希望不是某种运气转移。
Content.LocalizedString: I hope I'm not using up my good luck.

Content.SourceString: 这算纳库佩达的祝福吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Is this a blessing from Nacupeda?

Content.SourceString: 需要交给治安所吗……？
Content.LocalizedString: Do I need to turn this in to the Security Office?

Content.SourceString: 呼……需要补给一下。
Content.LocalizedString: Ugh… I need some supplies.

Content.SourceString: 没关系，我还能继续战斗。
Content.LocalizedString: It's okay. I can still fight.

Content.SourceString: 真麻烦啊……
Content.LocalizedString: So much trouble…

Content.SourceString: 现在，我状态好得能自己解决掉无首铁驭。
Content.LocalizedString: I feel so good I can solo the Headless Rider.

Content.SourceString: 状态万全，还有需要我解决的吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I'm in top condition. Are there more enemies to fight?

Content.SourceString: 这样也好……
Content.LocalizedString: This is good…

Content.SourceString: 到此为止了吗……
Content.LocalizedString: Is that it…?

Content.SourceString: 怎么能在这倒下……
Content.LocalizedString: I can't fall here…

Content.SourceString: 这就结束了？
Content.LocalizedString: Over already?

Content.SourceString: 我还以为会更棘手些。
Content.LocalizedString: I thought you'd be stronger.

Content.SourceString: 啧，大意了……
Content.LocalizedString: Tch, I was careless…

Content.SourceString: 擦伤而已。
Content.LocalizedString: It's just a scratch.

Content.SourceString: 呃……接下来该我了！
Content.LocalizedString: Urgh… it's my turn now!

Content.SourceString: ……会还给你的！
Content.LocalizedString: …I'll hit you back!

Content.SourceString: 把最强的家伙留给我。
Content.LocalizedString: Leave the strongest one to me.

Content.SourceString: 放心，我会把握好分寸。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry. I'll control myself.

Content.SourceString: 给我消停一点！
Content.LocalizedString: Knock it off!

Content.SourceString: 就这样安静下来吧！
Content.LocalizedString: I'll make sure you quiet down!

Content.SourceString: 这样的觉悟……可不够看！
Content.LocalizedString: Your commitment… is not enough!

Content.SourceString: 如果能更自由地飞起来……
Content.LocalizedString: If only I had wings…

Content.SourceString: 这也算是一种下楼的捷径。
Content.LocalizedString: Taking a shortcut down.

Content.SourceString: 退后。
Content.LocalizedString: Stay back.

Content.SourceString: 好了，我来接手……！
Content.LocalizedString: Alright, taking over…!

Content.SourceString: 来，跟我试试！
Content.LocalizedString: C'mon, let's fight!

Content.SourceString: 好好，薄荷「前辈」。
Content.LocalizedString: Fine, fine, Mint "senpai."

Content.SourceString: 负责好援护就行，天线羊。
Content.LocalizedString: Ramtenna, support me.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，我在。
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, this is Shinku.

Content.SourceString: 笨猫，不要强撑！
Content.LocalizedString: Dumcat, don't overdo it!

Content.SourceString: 休息会儿，我会让那家伙付出代价……！
Content.LocalizedString: Take a break. I'll make them pay…!

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，我不允许你倒下！
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, don't you fall on me!

Content.SourceString: 就这水平？
Content.LocalizedString: Is that it?

Content.SourceString: 还可以再用力点。
Content.LocalizedString: You can try harder.

Content.SourceString: 这就跟不上了？
Content.LocalizedString: Can't follow me?

Content.SourceString: 没有失误的理由。
Content.LocalizedString: No room for mistakes.
